about: Roy E. Fitzgerald, III attended law school and graduated from University at Buffalo Law School - SUNY in 1987. Roy Fitzgerald, III began practicing law in 1988.

Roy Fitzgerald, III is an attorney at Critton Luttier & Coleman, LLP, helping people with Business Litigation issues. Critton Luttier & Coleman, LLP has an office in West Palm Beach, Florida, serving the local community.

Roy Fitzgerald, III was selected to Super Lawyers for 2006 - 2026. Super Lawyers is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.
